title: palicourea guianensis subsp. barbinervia
intro: Palicourea guianensis subsp. barbinervia, commonly known as "erva de limão" or "limão", is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Palicourea guianensis subsp. barbinervia include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic agent, which can help alleviate various health conditions such as fever, pain, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions like arthritis and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Palicourea guianensis subsp. barbinervia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
